tagline: Refreshing Nigeria, One Cold Drink at a Time

sections.name: Hero
sections.copy: Welcome to Angeloma Beverage Co - Your trusted partner in cold chain beverage distribution across Nigeria. We ensure every drink reaches you perfectly chilled and refreshingly delicious. From Lagos to Ogun State and beyond, we deliver quality refreshments that keep Nigeria cool.
sections.imagePrompt: Photorealistic image of perfectly chilled bottled beverages with condensation droplets glistening on glass bottles, arranged in a modern cold storage facility with Nigerian tropical sunlight streaming through windows, vibrant colors of different drink bottles (orange, cola, water), professional commercial refrigeration units visible in background, clean and hygienic warehouse environment

sections.name: About Us
sections.copy:
Angeloma Drinks & Refreshments Limited is a leading FoodTech company specializing in cold chain logistics and beverage distribution. Based in Ogun State with operations extending across Lagos and beyond, we combine cutting-edge cold storage technology with reliable distribution networks to ensure beverages maintain optimal freshness from manufacturer to consumer.

Our expertise in cold chain management means every bottle, can, and package is transported and stored at the perfect temperature. We understand that in Nigeria's tropical climate, proper refrigeration isn't just about comfort—it's essential for quality and safety.

Whether you're a retailer, restaurant, event planner, or wholesaler, Angeloma Beverage Co delivers the refreshments your customers crave, exactly when and how you need them.
sections.imagePrompt: Wide-angle photorealistic shot of a modern Nigerian beverage distribution warehouse, rows of organized cold storage units filled with colorful drink products, professional logistics staff in branded uniforms checking inventory with tablets, delivery trucks visible through loading bay, bright clean facility with blue and white color scheme, professional foodtech operations

sections.name: Our Services
sections.copy:
**Cold Chain Distribution**
Temperature-controlled transportation ensuring your beverages arrive perfectly chilled. Our fleet of refrigerated vehicles covers Lagos, Ogun State, and surrounding regions with reliable daily deliveries.

**Bulk Beverage Supply**
Competitive wholesale pricing for retailers, supermarkets, restaurants, and event venues. We stock a comprehensive range of soft drinks, juices, bottled water, and energy drinks from trusted brands.

**Cold Storage Solutions**
Secure, hygienic storage facilities with 24/7 temperature monitoring. Perfect for businesses needing reliable cold storage for their beverage inventory.

**Event Beverage Supply**
Specialized service for weddings, corporate events, parties, and festivals. We deliver, set up cooling stations, and handle all your refreshment needs so you can focus on your guests.

**Retail Partnership Program**
Flexible supply agreements with competitive margins for small and medium retailers. We support your business growth with reliable stock availability and excellent service.
sections.imagePrompt: Split-screen photorealistic composition showing multiple aspects of beverage distribution: top half showing refrigerated delivery truck being loaded with crates of drinks by uniformed workers, bottom half showing organized retail display of colorful beverages in modern Nigerian supermarket coolers, professional lighting, emphasis on cold chain excellence and variety of products

sections.name: Why Choose Angeloma
sections.copy:
**Expert Cold Chain Management**
Our leadership brings professional cold chain logistics expertise, ensuring industry-leading temperature control and product quality throughout the distribution process.

**Reliable & Timely Delivery**
We understand the Nigerian business environment. Our dependable delivery schedules mean you never run out of stock when you need it most.

**Competitive Pricing**
Direct relationships with manufacturers and efficient operations allow us to offer excellent value without compromising on service quality or product freshness.

**Wide Coverage Area**
Serving Ogun State, Lagos, and expanding routes across Southwest Nigeria, we bring refreshing beverages to communities throughout the region.

**Quality Assurance**
Every product is handled with care, stored properly, and delivered in perfect condition. Your reputation depends on product quality—so does ours.
